text:
maria: Heads-up — CI linkcheck is failing for the migration guide after the MkDocs -> Docusaurus move. Seeing a bunch of broken anchors for headings that used to have special characters.

docs-ci-bot: linkcheck: FAILED on 1772004567: /docs/migration/v1-to-v2#why-upgrade -> 404

jordan: I can take a look. Is this the anchors-with-parentheses thing again? e.g. `(#how-it-works)` -> slug change

sahil: Yep. Docusaurus slugifier normalizes differently than MkDocs. We had a similar case with the SDK snippets where underscores turned to dashes.

emma: Quick test: locally running `npx docusaurus start` shows the anchor generated as `#why-upgrade--migration-notes` whereas old links were `#why-upgrade`.

maria: We have incoming docs PRs that still reference the old anchors. Should we 1) add redirects, 2) normalize heading text, or 3) update all links in PRs? Thoughts?

jordan: For short-term, redirects in Docusaurus seem easiest: add `redirects` frontmatter for those pages. Long term we should run a link-migration script that rewrites anchors in the repo.

ryan: I can add a tiny transform script in the docs CI that detects old-style anchors and maps them to new slugs before running linkcheck. It would also emit a warning to PR authors.

emma: Script idea: use the same slugify algorithm Docusaurus uses (lowercase, remove punctuation, replace spaces with `-`). I can paste the node snippet in the PR.

jordan: If we do redirects, remember to keep them scoped per-page. Otherwise we get noisy conflicts in the fullsite redirects file.

maria: Can we combine approaches? Redirects for the most hit pages (migration guide, SDK snippets), and a migration script to update the rest. I'll open a tracking PR with a checklist.

sahil: Also watch out for code fence titles. Docusaurus turns ```js title="example.js" ``` into a different anchor for the code block header; those were broken in one example.

jordan: Good catch. I'll grep for `title=` and add a small rule to the rewrite tool that preserves the expected anchors.

maria: Plan: jordan will add redirects for the migration guide pages (small PR), emma will add the slugify snippet to the CI script, ryan will wire up pre-linkcheck rewrite + warnings, sahil will audit code-fence anchors, and I'll coordinate updating incoming docs PRs and ping authors.

ryan: I'll base the rewrite on the `@docusaurus/utils` slugify function so we match exactly. Will add a `--dry-run` flag.

emma: Pasting quick node snippet for the slugify we should use:

```js
const {slugify} = require('@docusaurus/utils');
console.log(slugify('Why upgrade? — migration notes'));
// expected: why-upgrade-migration-notes
```

maria: Thanks. Can everyone drop a short comment on the tracking PR when their small change is ready so I can roll them together for a docs-only deploy?

jordan: Will do. I'll start the redirects PR now.

sahil: I'll run a grep for code-fence titles and post a list in the PR comments.

maria: Awesome — aim to get this in before tomorrow's release so the docs build stays green. :thumbsup:

docs-ci-bot: linkcheck: re-run scheduled in 30m (once the redirects PR lands the check should pass for the migration pages)
